title: Reading a gradual type checker
description: You can follow expression nodes through compatibility checks.

steps.description: The checker names Int, Bool, Str and the dynamic type Any. You represent expressions with dataclasses and variable types with a dictionary.
Literals return their declared type, while variables use the environment or Any. An annotation checks compatibility, and Add checks both operands against Int.
Eq returns Bool after checking operand compatibility. If checks its condition and both branch types before choosing a result type.

steps.question: Which result types do the first Add and Eq examples print?
steps.answer: The addition prints Int. The equality prints Bool.

steps.description: You see Int, Bool, Int and Int from the accepted examples. Adding name, whose type is Str, to an Int produces the caught Add requires Int error.
